purpose: Out-of-corpus control: discriminate frozen C*N/p, the N-1 candidate, and other-player coach anchoring, using one previously unseen player previewed on three ordinary coaches.

controlPlayer.selection: Chosen by the user from outside the corpus. Card (age, tier, established and learning roles, all 15 stats, white/grey appearance of affected stats) is supplied BEFORE any preview of that player.
controlPlayer.preferred: T0 (keeps the unexplained tiered grey/white anomaly out), age 18-21 (largest gains), several affected stats below about 100 (flat-zone rows read dose one-for-one).
controlPlayer.rule: Previews only; no coach is applied. Predictions are committed and pushed before the player's previews are supplied.

coaches.label: Standard Attacking
historicalAnchors: MARK-ORDINARY-X5 (21 Sep; programme recorded as unspecified, identical label, N and stat set)

models.A: Frozen response plus other-player coach anchor: log C shifted by the mean per-event dose offset of the listed historical anchors (anchor_offset in tools/resource-coach-v2/structure_audit.py). The control player's own previews are never used.

scoring.primary: Per coach and pooled: midpoint MAE, point-inside rate, interval overlap, endpoint MAE and signed residual of F, N1 and A against the control player's observed intervals.
scoring.pattern: After the previews, the control player's implied dose offset relative to F is computed per coach (endpoint least squares, frozen response). The log-dose vector is compared with each hypothesis's predicted vector; a common player factor is removed by comparing the vectors after subtracting their means (between-coach ratios).
decisions: Coach anchoring is supported if A has the lowest pooled midpoint MAE and the lowest between-coach pattern distance. It is falsified if the control's x10 implied dose relative to F is at least 0.865 (halfway between A 0.789 and N1 0.943) AND A is not the best pooled model.
N-1 is supported at low multiplier if the control's x5 implied dose relative to F is at most 0.92 (halfway between N1 0.838 and F 1.000); falsified if it is at least 0.92.
If the two best hypotheses are within 0.05 RMS in log-dose pattern distance the result is recorded as inconclusive, not as a win.
scoring.secondary: If the control is T0 and has a WHITE and a MID_GREY affected stat both below about 100 on the same coach, equal allocation predicts equal implied budgets (ratio 1.0 +/- 0.1).

leakageRules: The control player's previews never enter any prediction.
Historical anchors are fixed by this file before the control player is chosen.
Frozen baseline profile and frozen x59 predictions are not modified.
